items.title: 2026 LiveLaw (SC) 1067 | K Ramalingam and Others v. Government of Tamil Nadu and Others

items.excerpt: “A temple property is held for the deity and not for gratuitous disposal by whoever happens to hold the office of trustee, however well-intentioned,” the Court observed.

items.title: Homebuyer Cannot Claim Both Interest On Full Refund And Rent For Builder’s Same Delay: Supreme Court
items.excerpt: The Court held that interest compensated the homebuyer for being deprived of money that could have secured another home, making a separate rent award compensation for the same loss twice.

items.title: Gift Of Inam Property Dedicated To Support Of A Deity Is Void Ab Initio Under Tamil Nadu HR & CE Act: Supreme Court
items.excerpt: The Bench said that the State is a custodian, not owner, of temple property and upheld the lease at enhanced rent of Rs. 31,000 per month and imposed costs on Tamil Nadu.
